verdict.rationale: NVIDIA claims the H200 shares the same power profile as H100 while delivering higher performance, implying improved perf/watt, but this is a vendor marketing statement, not a documented power envelope spec (TDP figures) with independent perf/watt benchmarking. No third-party power-efficiency testing is present in the evidence. missing for 10: independent perf-per-watt benchmarks, detailed TDP/power envelope documentation, sustained-workload thermal/power testing.
